adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: After the Battle of New York, Natasha hands Loki's scepter to Sitwell in Stark Tower, not knowing he means to deliver it to HYDRA.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger who hands Sitwell Loki's scepter in Stark Tower.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent Natasha unknowingly hands Loki's scepter to.
adds.evidence: 2012 New York heist: Sitwell and STRIKE arrive at Stark Tower and collect the scepter from Natasha ('We can take that off your hands.' 'By all means.'), on Pierce's orders to take it to HYDRA.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Steve stops Sitwell in a Stark Tower elevator and whispers "Hail Hydra" to him, tricking him into handing over Loki's scepter.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tricks Sitwell out of Loki's scepter with a whispered "Hail Hydra."
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A HYDRA agent Steve tricks into handing over Loki's scepter.
adds.evidence: 2012 New York heist: Steve approaches Sitwell and Rumlow in the elevator, Sitwell wants to call Fury, Steve whispers 'Hail Hydra' and Sitwell gives him the scepter.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Korg and Miek live with Thor in New Asgard, where Miek watches Korg play video games, and they fight side by side against Thanos's army.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A housemate at Thor's in New Asgard, and a partner in the final battle.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A housemate at Thor's in New Asgard, and a partner in the final battle.
adds.evidence: Thor introduces 'my friends, Miek, Korg' to Hulk in his New Asgard house; Miek watches Korg play video games for five years; Miek fights alongside Korg in the Battle of Earth.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Korg keeps Thor company in New Asgard through five years of despair, and Thor threatens an online gamer who insults him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The friend whose house Korg shares in New Asgard. Threatens a gamer who insults him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who keeps Thor company through five dark years in New Asgard.
adds.evidence: In Thor's house in New Asgard Korg plays video games and keeps Thor company; when NoobMaster69 insults Korg, Thor threatens the player; Korg warns Banner not to say Thanos's name around Thor.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: After Loki's defeat in New York, Natasha takes charge of his scepter in Stark Tower while he sits captured among the Avengers.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger who takes Loki's scepter after his defeat.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The captured god whose scepter Natasha takes.
adds.evidence: 2012 New York heist: with Loki defeated and held at arrow point by Clint in Stark Tower, Natasha takes Loki's scepter and later hands it to Sitwell.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Captured after the Battle of New York, Loki mocks Steve in Stark Tower before Thor gags him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A captor Loki mocks after his defeat in New York.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The captive god who mocks Steve after the Battle of New York.
adds.evidence: 2012 New York heist: Loki is apprehended by the Avengers and mocks Captain America before Thor gags him with a collar.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Tony escorts the captured Loki out of Stark Tower while carrying the Tesseract. When the case falls in the chaos of Tony's heist, Loki grabs the Tesseract and escapes.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A captor whose dropped Tesseract Loki grabs to escape.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The captive god who escapes with the Tesseract Tony loses.
adds.evidence: 2012 New York heist: Tony and Thor escort Loki to the lobby with Tony holding the Tesseract case; the present-day Stark and Lang's attempt to steal it fails, the case slides to Loki's feet and he escapes with it.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Mantis rejoins Nebula and the other Guardians on the Benatar, and both cheer on a fight when Thor and Quill argue over who leads.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate back on the Benatar, who joins in the banter over who leads.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate back on the Benatar, who joins in the banter over who leads.
adds.evidence: After the funeral, Nebula rejoins the Guardians (Rocket, Drax, Mantis, Groot, Quill) on the Benatar; Thor and Quill quarrel over leadership and Nebula and Mantis join in suggesting a fight.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Back aboard the Benatar with Thor, Mantis eagerly backs Rocket's offer of knives when Thor and Quill argue over who leads.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate whose offer of knives Mantis eagerly backs.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who eagerly backs Rocket's offer of knives.
adds.evidence: On the Benatar Rocket says 'I got some blasters unless you guys want to use knives?' and Mantis replies 'Oh, yes, please use knives.'
